verdict.rationale: Claude documents native creation and editing of Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and PDF files via natural language prompts, with downloadable exports, plus support for reading many document formats (PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, etc.) and Artifacts for iterative document/content creation within chats. Cowork extends this to producing formatted documents and organized files as deliverables. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the export-file quality or fidelity beyond first-party docs.
